question: Can all daily festivals and related rites be performed in the provisional shrine?
premises: Daily festivals and related rites are required observances.
A provisional shrine may serve as a temporary locus.
Ritual continuity must be maintained during transition.
inference: All daily festivals and related rites should be caused to be performed even in the provisional shrine.
plain_english: One should have all the daily festivals and other rites performed even in the provisional shrine.
